display.purpose: Hero name only; rests at SOFT 100 / WONK 0. Entrance is y+opacity settle, never axis animation.

headline.purpose: Section titles: Today's brew, On the menu, Let's talk.

body.purpose: Taglines and entry descriptions within the 672px measure.

mono.purpose: Greet line, meta rows, tech-stack middot tags.

motion.name: ease-settle
motion.purpose: Gauge-settle easing for all entrances; one rise, then quiet. Disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Espresso-tile solid fill, cream uppercase label. The one strong action voice.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: oklch(0.398 0.094 49); color: oklch(0.951 0.032 73.5); font: 600 0.75rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.398 0.094 49 / 80%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3 / 30%); border-color: oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Hairline-border secondary action; fills with sage wash on hover.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; height: 40px; padding: 0 24px; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.228 0.022 60.1); font: 600 0.75rem/1 system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; border: 1px solid oklch(0.836 0.059 122.6); border-radius: 0; transition: background 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: oklch(0.914 0.044 122.7); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3 / 30%); border-color: oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3); }

components.name: The Special Chip
components.description: Signature chip: the day's special (current role) as uppercase Fraunces on a sage field.
components.css: .ds-chip-special { display: inline-block; background: oklch(0.914 0.044 122.7); color: oklch(0.228 0.022 60.1); padding: 0 8px; font-family: Georgia, serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 0.875rem; letter-spacing: 0.1em; text-transform: uppercase; line-height: 28px; border-radius: 0; }

components.name: Mono Meta Row
components.description: Small mono middot rows: greet line, org · dates, tech stacks.
components.css: .ds-mono-meta { font-family: ui-monospace, monospace; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1.6; color: oklch(0.41 0.045 63.4); }

components.name: Green Link
components.description: Text links in Deep Leaf with hairline underlines; hover deepens.
components.css: .ds-link { color: oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3); font-size: 0.875rem; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: oklch(0.836 0.059 122.6); text-underline-offset: 4px; transition: text-decoration-color 0.2s; } .ds-link:hover { text-decoration-color: oklch(0.456 0.101 128.3); }

narrative.overview: The portfolio set as the menu board of a café whose product is an engineer: one cream-paper board scanned in a single pass, espresso ink writing, deep olive acting, matcha sage tinting fields between hairlines. The visitor is greeted at the door (welcome in! I'm), reads the day's special, the standing menu, and lands at the counter. Depth is tonal, never shadowed; motion settles like a gauge.
keyCharacteristics: Two-hue brown-green family; green is architectural (links, fields, rules), never garnish walls
Squared components, uppercase mono-tracked labels, no kickers
Fraunces display at rest (SOFT 100), DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono small print
Single ~672px measure with 1px sage hairline separators and 80px section rhythm
Gauge-settle motion, fully disabled under prefers-reduced-motion

rules.name: The Ink Rule
rules.body: Espresso writes and acts; green connects and tints; cream is paper. If a surface reads green, it is a field or a link — never a wall of green text.

rules.name: The Warm-Temperature Rule
rules.body: Every neutral leans warm (sand/sage hue 60–130°); pure gray (0 chroma) and cool blue are foreign to this world.

rules.name: The Cream Ledger Rule
rules.body: Body text is Espresso Ink (14.7:1), never Matcha Sage; green text is Deep Leaf only, after contrast verification.

rules.name: The Lowercase Voice Rule
rules.body: The greet line and CTA echo the brand's lowercase voice; buttons stay uppercase.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest; state is expressed with tonal steps and hairlines, never elevation or shadows.

dos: Do keep the two-hue discipline: espresso writes and acts; green links, tints, and rings; cream stays paper.
Do keep every neutral warm: sage/sand hues 60–130°, chroma ≥ 0.02.
Do use hairlines (1px, --border) and tonal steps for all structure and depth.
Do set display text in Fraunces resting at SOFT 100, WONK 0; motion is fade/settle, never axis animation.
Do keep the greet line lowercase mono — it is the page's opening voice.
Do keep tech tags as inline mono middot lists in the entry title row.
Do keep evidence numerals (60%, 50%, 4 mini PCs, 3 teams) at Espresso Ink weight inside Espresso Ash prose.
Do keep links green (Deep Leaf) with hairline underlines, deepening on hover.
Do keep the resume one click away: /resume serves docs/resume.md.
Do gate all motion behind prefers-reduced-motion; expo.out fade/settle grammar.
Do keep browser chrome (favicon, apple icon) in the espresso-tile family.
donts: Don't reintroduce the lavender night world; light-only is the committed world.
Don't introduce gradients, glassmorphism, or ambient glows — flat tonal layers only.
Don't round component corners; squared is the form language (utility chrome only).
Don't use Matcha Sage for text on cream (1.3:1); green text is Deep Leaf only, after contrast math.
Don't use pure gray or cool-blue neutrals; every neutral keeps its warm temperature.
Don't add a third hue; terracotta is destructive-only, chart tones stay for data-viz.
Don't let body text exceed the ~672px measure; no multi-column reading layouts.
Don't animate Fraunces axes; that was the previous world's signature.
Don't fabricate numbers, testimonials, or projects — copy comes from documented work only.
